title: Install & run the Federation Hub
breadcrumb: Federation Hub: connecting multiple TAK Servers

blocks.html:
The FedHub installs from the same TAK Server distribution (package takserver-fed-hub-*) and runs on its own host, separate from any TAK Server. This page is a deployment summary — the official Federation Hub Configuration Guide has the step-by-step per-OS commands.

Prerequisites

  • Java 17
  • A supported OS: RHEL/Rocky 8 (or 7/CentOS), Ubuntu 22/24
  • ~4 cores / 8 GB RAM / 20 GB disk
  • MongoDB — optional, only for Mission Federation Disruption Tolerance (MFDT) (store-and-forward of Data Sync / mission changes during disconnects between the hub and other hubs/TAK Servers). Configure credentials in federation-hub-broker.yml.

Install (pick one)

  • RPM (RHEL/Rocky): install Java 17, then sudo dnf install takserver-fed-hub-*.noarch.rpm -y (on RHEL/Rocky 8 also apply SELinux via the bundled apply-selinux.sh).

  • DEB (Ubuntu, 5.1+): sudo apt install <path>/takserver-fed-hub_*.deb -y.

  • Docker: build the fedhub image and run it exposing the federation/UI ports:

    docker network create fedhub-"$(cat tak/version.txt)"
docker build -t fedhub:"$(cat tak/version.txt)" -f docker/Dockerfile.fedhub .
docker run -d -v $(pwd)/tak:/opt/tak:z -it \
  -p 9100:9100 -p 9101:9101 -p 9102:9102 \
  --network fedhub-"$(cat tak/version.txt)" \
  --name fedhub-"$(cat tak/version.txt)" fedhub:"$(cat tak/version.txt)"

Installed location is /opt/tak/federation-hub/.

Start it

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable federation-hub
sudo systemctl restart federation-hub

sudo firewall-cmd --zone=public --add-port=9100/tcp --permanent
sudo firewall-cmd --zone=public --add-port=9102/tcp --permanent
sudo firewall-cmd --reload

(Cloud: add the same to security groups / ingress rules.)

Configuration files

Two YAML files under /opt/tak/federation-hub/configs/ drive everything:

  • **federation-hub-broker.yml** — federation + messaging (ports, token-auth servers, MongoDB credentials, keystore/truststore).
  • **federation-hub-ui.yml** — the admin UI (access, Keycloak/OAuth, authorized-users file location).

The defaults assume a takserver.jks server keystore and a fed-truststore.jks federation truststore. If you use different names, set them (and the keyAlias matching your server cert) in both files.
